classification: AI-composed campaign banners based on original SNJB photographs; not documentary evidence of facilities or people
direction: Professional institutional composition, welcoming photographic light, teal/violet negative space and restrained orange optical curves. Desktop subject to the right; portrait subject above. No baked headings, logos or slogans. Faculty portraits are not regenerated.
originals: The selected GPT Image PNG originals are retained with -source.png suffix; WebP variants are delivery encodings.
limitations: Generation aesthetically reinterprets framing, light and some scene details. Artwork is labelled and must not be presented as untouched institutional photography. Campus motion uses separately credited authentic archival footage.
